# MyLogix Studio

MyLogix Studio LLC designs and develops focused websites, web applications, mobile applications, and data products.

## Products

- [Stemmoire](https://stemmoire.mylogicstudio.com/): An AI floral design and virtual flower-arranging application that helps people turn everyday flowers, art, or saved inspiration into realistic, buildable bouquet directions.
  - [Design a bouquet](https://stemmoire.mylogicstudio.com/design)
  - [Arrange flowers online](https://stemmoire.mylogicstudio.com/arrange)
  - [Explore art-inspired bouquets](https://stemmoire.mylogicstudio.com/art)
- [TickerCase](https://tickercase.mylogicstudio.com/): A tool for translating stock predictions into evidence, required results, and dated checkpoints.
- [ColorCrafter](https://www.mylogicstudio.com/products#colorcrafter): A mobile product that turns personal photos into printable numbered artwork.
